_note: Scripted test calls written for this project, modelled on scam patterns described in PDRM/NSRC advisories and Malaysian news reports. All names, organisations' staff, phone and account numbers are fictitious.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Selamat petang puan. Saya Sarjan Tan dari Ibu Pejabat Polis Bukit Aman, Jabatan Siasatan Jenayah Komersial.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Ya, ada apa encik?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Kami dapati nombor kad pengenalan puan telah digunakan untuk membuka akaun bank yang terlibat dalam kes pengubahan wang haram.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Hah? Saya tak pernah buka akaun lain.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Mahkamah sudah keluarkan waran tangkap atas nama puan. Kalau puan tak bekerjasama, puan akan ditangkap dalam masa 24 jam.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Ya Allah, apa saya perlu buat?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Kes ini sulit. Jangan beritahu sesiapa, termasuk anak-anak puan. Jangan letak telefon.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Untuk buktikan puan tidak bersalah, puan perlu pindahkan semua simpanan ke akaun selamat Bank Negara untuk siasatan.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Sila catat nombor akaun ini: 7612 4409 8831. Masukkan RM48,000 hari ini juga.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, good morning. This is Encik Faizal from LHDN, Lembaga Hasil Dalam Negeri, Jalan Duta branch.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Yes, ada apa?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Our record shows you have tunggakan cukai of RM12,850 from year 2023. If not settled today, you will be blacklisted and your account will be frozen.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: But I always pay tax on time.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Maybe someone used your name. Saman mahkamah already issued, so you must settle immediately to stop the court case.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please bank in the money to our officer account, Maybank 5140 2267 9031, and WhatsApp me the receipt at 011-2876 4410.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Don't tell your family first, this matter is confidential.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello aunty, I'm calling from CIMB credit card centre. Got one transaction RM6,900 at Lazada just now, aunty make or not?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: No lah, I never buy anything.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: OK aunty, don't worry, we will cancel it for you. Aunty will receive one SMS with TAC number now, just read the six digit code to me.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Wait ah, let me see.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Quickly aunty, the code expire in 2 minutes. Also need your card number and the CVV behind to verify.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: If you don't give now, the transaction will go through and you lose the money.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, ini panggilan dari Pos Laju. Bungkusan atas nama encik telah ditahan oleh kastam kerana mengandungi dadah dan pasport palsu.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Saya tak hantar apa-apa bungkusan pun.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Saya akan sambungkan panggilan encik kepada pegawai polis Kuala Lumpur sekarang.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Inspektor Rahman bercakap. Nombor telefon encik juga dikaitkan dengan sindiket ini. Encik sekarang dalam siasatan.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Untuk elakkan encik ditangkap, muat turun aplikasi ini melalui pautan yang saya hantar supaya kami boleh semak akaun bank encik.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Jangan bincang dengan sesiapa. Ini kes sulit.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: This is MCMC. Your phone line will be disconnected within 2 hours. Press 1 to speak to an officer.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello sir, I'm officer Lim from MCMC. Your number was used to send scam messages and a police report was made in Sabah.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: What? I never send anything.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I will connect you to Sabah police. Sir, the police say you need to transfer RM20,000 to a safe account for verification. It will be returned after 3 days.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Account number 8823 0045 1176, Public Bank. Please go to a room by yourself and don't hang up the phone.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi uncle, I'm Jessica from Golden Harvest Capital. We have a special investment plan for senior citizens, guaranteed returns of 15% per month.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Many uncles and aunties already join, very safe, approved by Bank Negara.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Sounds good, but how to join?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: You just need to transfer RM5,000 to start, and you can withdraw anytime. But this offer only until today, last chance.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I will send you a link, just click the link and install our app to see your profit.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good afternoon, this is Aisyah from Maybank Fraud Monitoring. Am I speaking to Mr Lee?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Yes, speaking.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We noticed a card transaction of RM1,250 at an online store at 2.14 pm today. Did you make this purchase?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Yes, that was me, I bought a new phone.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Thank you for confirming, no further action is needed. As a reminder, Maybank will never ask you for your OTP, PIN or password, and will never ask you to transfer money to another account.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: If you ever receive such a request, please hang up and call the number on the back of your card. Have a good day.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Assalamualaikum, ini Klinik Kesihatan Taman Melawati. Boleh saya bercakap dengan Puan Rosnah?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Ya, saya.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Saya nak ingatkan temujanji pemeriksaan darah puan esok pukul 9 pagi. Sila berpuasa sejak tengah malam.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Bawa kad pengenalan dan buku temujanji ya. Kalau tak dapat datang, boleh telefon klinik untuk tukar tarikh.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Baik, terima kasih.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, J&T delivery here. I got one parcel for you, I'm at the guardhouse now but cannot find your house.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Oh, I'm at block C, level 5.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: OK, the guard ask me to leave the parcel at the guardhouse, can or not? Or you want to come down?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Just leave with the guard, thanks.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: OK no problem, I take photo as proof of delivery. Thank you.

scenarios.title_en: Son asks for RM50 for parking

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Ma, Wei Jie here. I'm at the hospital car park with Papa, the parking machine only takes card.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Can you bank in RM50 to my account? I'll pay you back tonight.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Your father got no card ah?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Oh never mind, Papa found his card already. See you at home for dinner.
